#![forbid(unsafe_code)]
use std::{
    env, fs,
    process::{self, Command},
    thread,
    time::Duration,
};
fn main() {
    let executable = env::current_exe().expect("helper executable");
    if executable
        .file_stem()
        .is_some_and(|name| name == "askpass-helper")
    {
        fs::write(
            executable
                .parent()
                .expect("helper directory")
                .join("askpass-called"),
            "called",
        )
        .expect("record actual askpass invocation");
        process::exit(1);
    }
    let args: Vec<_> = env::args_os().collect();
    if args.get(1).is_some_and(|mode| mode == "sleep") {
        thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(60));
        return;
    }
    let Some(mode) = args.get(1).and_then(|mode| mode.to_str()) else {
        process::exit(2)
    };
    let Some(marker) = args.get(2) else {
        process::exit(2)
    };
    match mode {
        "known-hosts" => eprintln!("known_hosts: authentication failed: connection refused"),
        "askpass-env" => {
            let present = if env::var_os("GIT_ASKPASS").is_some_and(|value| !value.is_empty()) {
                "inherited"
            } else {
                ""
            };
            let output = format!(
                "askpass={present}\nterminal_prompt={}\n",
                env::var("GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT").unwrap_or_default()
            );
            fs::write(marker, output).expect("write public environment projection");
        }
        "askpass-call" => fs::write(marker, "called").expect("record actual askpass invocation"),
        "timeout" => {
            let mut child = Command::new(env::current_exe().expect("helper executable"))
                .arg("sleep")
                .spawn()
                .expect("start real descendant");
            let temporary = std::path::PathBuf::from(marker).with_extension("tmp");
            fs::write(&temporary, format!("{}\n", child.id())).expect("write complete PID");
            fs::rename(temporary, marker).expect("publish complete PID atomically");
            let status = child.wait().expect("wait for descendant");
            process::exit(status.code().unwrap_or(2));
        }
        _ => process::exit(2),
    }
    process::exit(1);
}
